title: EHIC scope: public-system care that becomes necessary, not travel insurance
fact_en: The European Health Insurance Card (EHIC) gives access to state-provided healthcare that becomes medically necessary during a temporary stay in another EU/EEA country or Switzerland, on the same terms as locals. It does not cover private healthcare, planned treatment or rescue and repatriation (transport home), for which separate insurance is needed.
fact_ko: 유럽건강보험카드(EHIC)는 다른 EU/EEA 국가나 스위스에 일시 체류하는 동안 의학적으로 필요해진 공공 의료를 현지인과 같은 조건으로 받게 해 준다. 민간 의료, 계획된 치료, 구조·본국 이송은 보장하지 않으므로 별도 보험이 필요하다.
common_misconceptions: The EHIC is a full travel insurance that covers rescue and repatriation home
The EHIC covers private clinics in the other country
The EHIC covers planned treatment (e.g. a scheduled operation) abroad
The EHIC is valid for residence abroad for any duration

title: 112 is the single European emergency number, free of charge
fact_en: Every end-user in the EU can reach emergency services free of charge, from any phone and without any means of payment, by dialling the single European emergency number 112 (alongside any national emergency numbers).
fact_ko: EU의 모든 최종 이용자는 어떤 전화로든 결제 수단 없이 무료로 단일 유럽 긴급전화 112(국가별 긴급번호와 병행)를 통해 응급 서비스에 연결할 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: 112 only works in the country where the SIM card was issued
112 is only for fire and police; ambulances need 144
Calling 112 requires credit or a SIM card with a plan
112 replaced national emergency numbers such as 911 or 999 and those no longer work

title: Cross-border healthcare reimbursement capped at home-country tariff
fact_en: Under the Cross-Border Healthcare Directive, the Member State of affiliation reimburses (or pays directly) cross-border healthcare only if the care is a benefit in the patient's home system, up to the cost it would have covered at home and never above the actual cost; prior authorisation may be required for certain care.
fact_ko: 환자 권리 지침에 따라 가입국은 본국 보험 급여에 해당하는 의료에 한해, 본국에서 부담했을 비용을 한도로 하고 실제 비용을 넘지 않는 범위에서 국경 간 의료비를 상환(또는 직접 지급)한다. 일부 의료는 사전 승인이 요구될 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: Full actual costs are always reimbursed regardless of the home tariff
Prior authorisation is never allowed
Reimbursement is available for any treatment, including ones not covered at home
The EHIC is needed for planned treatment abroad under the Directive

title: GDPR: health data is special-category; access answer within one month
fact_en: Data concerning health is special-category data whose processing is prohibited unless an Art. 9(2) exception applies. A patient has a right of access (Art. 15) and the controller must answer within one month of receipt, extendable by two further months for complex or numerous requests with notice.
fact_ko: 건강 관련 정보는 GDPR 제9조(2)의 예외에 해당하지 않는 한 처리가 금지되는 특수범주 정보이다. 환자는 열람권(제15조)이 있으며 처리자는 요청 접수 후 1개월 이내에 응답해야 하고, 복잡하거나 요청이 많으면 통지 후 2개월 연장할 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: The controller has 30 days and no extension is possible
The controller has 72 hours to answer an access request
Health data may be processed freely if the hospital is public
A fee is always charged for the first copy

title: European Health Data Space: application dates 2027 / 2029 / 2031
fact_en: The EHDS Regulation (EU) 2025/327 applies generally from 26 March 2027; most primary-use rules (patient access to electronic health data, interoperability of priority categories) phase in from 26 March 2029 and some data categories and EHR-system rules later (2031). It is not yet applicable on 2026-11-01.
fact_ko: 유럽 보건데이터공간(EHDS) 규정 (EU) 2025/327은 2027년 3월 26일부터 일반 적용되며, 환자의 전자 건강데이터 접근 등 1차 이용 규정은 2029년 3월 26일부터, 일부 범주와 EHR 시스템 규정은 2031년까지 단계적으로 적용된다. 2026-11-01 현재 아직 적용 전이다.
recent_change_note: Phased application dates fixed: 26 Mar 2027 (general), 26 Mar 2029 (Chapter IV secondary use; priority categories), 26 Mar 2031 (further categories / EHR systems).
common_misconceptions: EHDS rights are already applicable from 2025
All EHDS rules apply from 26 March 2027 at once
EHDS applies only from 2035
EHDS replaces the GDPR for health data

title: AI in medical devices: high-risk obligations delayed to 2 Aug 2028 (Digital Omnibus)
fact_en: AI systems that are medical devices or safety components of them (products under the Medical Devices Regulation 2017/745, Annex I of the AI Act) are high-risk under Art. 6(1). Since the Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, in force since July 2026), their high-risk obligations apply from 2 August 2028 instead of 2 August 2027.
fact_ko: 의료기기이거나 의료기기의 안전 구성요소인 AI 시스템(AI법 부속서 I의 의료기기규정 2017/745 대상 제품)은 제6조(1)에 따라 고위험이다. 디지털 옴니버스(규정 (EU) 2026/1744, 2026년 7월 발효)로 고위험 의무 적용일이 2027년 8월 2일에서 2028년 8월 2일로 연기되었다.
legal_basis: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Art. 6(1), Annex I; Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (amends Art. 113)
effective_date: 2026-07-27 (Omnibus in force); high-risk Annex I from 2028-08-02
recent_change_note: Digital Omnibus on AI (Reg. (EU) 2026/1744, OJ 24.7.2026) moved Annex I high-risk application from 2 Aug 2027 to 2 Aug 2028 and Annex III to 2 Dec 2027.
common_misconceptions: High-risk AI medical device rules apply from 2 August 2026
The deadline for Annex I products is still 2 August 2027
Medical-device AI is outside the AI Act because the MDR already applies
The delay applies to the Art. 5 prohibitions too

title: Online pharmacies: the common EU logo and the national register link
fact_en: Persons offering medicines at a distance to the public must display the common EU logo (design fixed by Implementing Regulation 699/2014) on their website, linked to the national competent authority's list of authorised sellers, so the public can check legitimacy. The logo shows the Member State of establishment.
fact_ko: 일반 대중에게 의약품을 원격 판매하는 자는 자사 웹사이트에 공통 EU 로고(시행규칙 699/2014가 디자인 규정)를 표시하고 이를 국가 감독기관의 허가 판매자 목록에 링크해야 하며, 대중이 적법성을 확인할 수 있어야 한다. 로고는 설립 회원국을 알려 준다.
legal_basis: Directive 2001/83/EC Art. 85c; Implementing Regulation (EU) No 699/2014 Arts. 1-3
common_misconceptions: Any website with a green cross is a legal pharmacy
The EU logo certifies that the medicine is effective and safe for the buyer
Online sale of medicines to the public is banned in the EU
The logo is only needed for prescription-only medicines

title: Medical devices: the manufacturer is responsible for conformity and the CE marking
fact_en: Under the Medical Devices Regulation (EU) 2017/745 the manufacturer must ensure the device is designed and manufactured in line with the Regulation before placing it on the market; devices considered conformant bear the CE marking. The CE mark is a conformity claim, not a health-authority approval of clinical benefit.
fact_ko: 의료기기규정 (EU) 2017/745에 따라 제조업자는 기기를 시장에 출시하기 전에 규정에 맞게 설계·제조되었음을 보장해야 하며, 적합한 것으로 간주되는 기기에는 CE 마크가 부착된다. CE 마크는 적합성 주장이지 보건당국의 임상적 효능 승인이 아니다.
common_misconceptions: CE marking means a regulator tested and approved the device's clinical effectiveness
Distributors, not manufacturers, are responsible for conformity
CE marking is voluntary for medical devices
CE marking is a quality award from the EU Commission

title: Deposit guarantee: EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank, repaid within 7 working days
fact_en: EU deposit guarantee schemes protect aggregate deposits of each depositor at a failed credit institution up to EUR 100,000, and the repayable amount must be available within seven working days of the authority's determination that deposits are unavailable.
fact_ko: EU 예금자보호제도는 부실 신용기관에 있는 예금자 1인당 합산 예금을 10만 유로까지 보호하며, 예금 지급불능 판정 후 7영업일 이내에 상환 가능 금액이 지급 가능해야 한다.
common_misconceptions: The guarantee is EUR 50,000 per deposit
The guarantee is EUR 100,000 per account, so several accounts at one bank are each covered
Repayment takes 20 working days
Repayment takes 3 months

title: Verification of Payee: free service for euro-area banks from 9 October 2025
fact_en: Under the Instant Payments Regulation, payment service providers in euro-area Member States had to offer instant euro credit transfers (sending) and a free Verification-of-Payee check (payee name vs IBAN) by 9 October 2025; instant transfers must not cost more than ordinary transfers. Non-euro Member States follow in 2027.
fact_ko: 즉시결제 규정에 따라 유로존 회원국의 결제서비스제공자는 2025년 10월 9일까지 유로 즉시 계좌이체(송금) 서비스와 무료 수취인 확인(수취인 이름과 IBAN 대조)을 제공해야 했다. 즉시이체 수수료는 일반 이체보다 높을 수 없다. 비유로 회원국은 2027년에 뒤따른다.
recent_change_note: Verification of Payee became mandatory for euro-area PSPs on 9 Oct 2025 (non-euro states 9 Jul 2027).
common_misconceptions: Verification of Payee is optional and may be charged
The check is a guarantee that the payee is not a fraudster
Instant transfers may cost more than ordinary transfers
Verification of Payee started in January 2025

title: MiCA: crypto-asset service provider transitional period ended 1 July 2026
fact_en: Crypto-asset service providers operating lawfully before 30 December 2024 could continue until 1 July 2026 or until authorisation was granted or refused, whichever came first (Member States could shorten it). Since 1 July 2026 unauthorised CASPs may not serve EU clients.
fact_ko: 2024년 12월 30일 이전에 적법하게 서비스를 제공하던 암호자산서비스제공자는 2026년 7월 1일 또는 인가 부여·거부 시점 중 빠른 때까지 계속할 수 있었다(회원국은 단축 가능). 2026년 7월 1일 이후 미인가 CASP는 EU 고객에게 서비스할 수 없다.
recent_change_note: The maximum MiCA CASP grandfathering period ended on 1 July 2026.
common_misconceptions: The transitional period lasts until December 2027
Any platform registered in one Member State before 2024 is permanently exempt
MiCA guarantees crypto investments like a deposit guarantee
The transitional period ended 30 December 2024

title: PSD2: refund of unauthorised payments by the end of the next business day
fact_en: If a payment was unauthorised, the payer's bank must refund immediately and in any event by the end of the following business day after noting or being notified, unless it has reasonable grounds to suspect fraud (by the payer) and reports them in writing to the national authority.
fact_ko: 승인되지 않은 결제의 경우 지급인의 은행은 이를 인지하거나 통지받은 후 즉시, 늦어도 다음 영업일 종료 전까지 환급해야 한다. 다만 은행이 (지급인의) 사기를 의심할 합리적 근거가 있고 이를 서면으로 국가 당국에 알린 경우는 예외이다.
common_misconceptions: The bank has 30 days to refund
The consumer must always bear the first EUR 500 of losses
Refund is only due if a police report is filed within 24 hours
The bank may refuse refund simply because the customer authenticated with a PIN

title: New Consumer Credit Directive applies from 20 November 2026
fact_en: Directive (EU) 2023/2225 on consumer credit repeals Directive 2008/48/EC; Member States had to adopt national rules by 20 November 2025 and must apply them from 20 November 2026 (existing credit agreements on that date are generally excluded). It extends to e.g. buy-now-pay-later and strengthens creditworthiness and information rules.
fact_ko: 소비자신용 지침 (EU) 2023/2225는 지침 2008/48/EC를 대체한다. 회원국은 2025년 11월 20일까지 국내 규정을 채택하고 2026년 11월 20일부터 적용해야 한다(그 날짜에 존재하는 기존 신용계약은 원칙적으로 제외). 선구매후결제(BNPL) 등으로 범위가 확대되고 신용평가·정보 규정이 강화된다.
recent_change_note: National rules under the new CCD apply from 20 Nov 2026, i.e. 19 days after 2026-11-01.
common_misconceptions: The new rules already apply since 2025-11-20
The new CCD applies from 20 November 2027
Existing credit agreements are fully re-written on the application date
The Directive only covers loans above EUR 1,000

title: AML Regulation: EUR 10,000 EU-wide cash payment limit, applying from 10 July 2027
fact_en: The new EU AML Regulation sets a Union-wide limit of EUR 10,000 for cash payments for goods or services by persons trading in goods or providing services (single or linked operations); Member States may set lower limits. The Regulation applies from 10 July 2027, so it is not yet in force on 2026-11-01.
fact_ko: 신규 EU 자금세탁방지 규정은 상품·서비스 거래자의 현금 결제에 대해 단일 또는 연결된 거래 합계 1만 유로의 EU 공통 한도를 둔다. 회원국은 더 낮은 한도를 정할 수 있다. 이 규정은 2027년 7월 10일부터 적용되므로 2026-11-01 현재는 아직 적용 전이다.
recent_change_note: EU-wide EUR 10,000 cash limit and other AMLR rules apply from 10 July 2027.
common_misconceptions: The EU-wide cash limit is EUR 1,000
The EUR 10,000 limit applies to bank deposits
The limit already applies since 2025
Member States may not set lower limits

title: Right to a payment account with basic features for legal residents
fact_en: Consumers legally resident in the EU, including those with no fixed address, asylum seekers and some who cannot be expelled, have the right to open and use a payment account with basic features with credit institutions in the Member State concerned.
fact_ko: 고정 주소가 없는 사람, 난민신청자, 추방이 불가능한 일부 사람을 포함해 EU에 합법적으로 거주하는 소비자는 해당 회원국의 신용기관에서 기본 기능 결제계좌를 개설·이용할 권리가 있다.
common_misconceptions: Banks may refuse any applicant who has bad credit history
Only citizens of the Member State have this right
A permanent address is required
The basic account must be free of any charge

title: Cross-border euro payments cost the same as domestic ones
fact_en: Charges for cross-border payments in euro within the EU must be the same as the charges the provider levies for corresponding national payments of the same value in the national currency.
fact_ko: EU 내 유로 국경 간 결제 수수료는 해당 제공자가 같은 금액의 국내 결제(자국 통화)에 부과하는 수수료와 같아야 한다.
common_misconceptions: Cross-border euro transfers may carry a higher fee than domestic ones
The rule only covers transfers within the euro area
The rule covers all currencies and all non-EU transfers
Fees must be zero

title: Distance/online purchases: 14-day withdrawal, extended by up to 12 months if not informed
fact_en: Consumers have 14 days to withdraw from a distance or off-premises contract without giving a reason; if the trader failed to give the required information on the right of withdrawal, the period expires 12 months after the end of the initial 14 days. From 19 June 2026 traders selling online must also offer a withdrawal function (Directive (EU) 2023/2673).
fact_ko: 소비자는 원격·방문판매 계약을 이유 없이 14일 이내에 철회할 수 있으며, 사업자가 철회권 정보를 제공하지 않았다면 철회 기간은 최초 14일이 끝난 때부터 12개월 후에 만료된다. 2026년 6월 19일부터 온라인 판매 사업자는 철회 기능도 제공해야 한다(지침 (EU) 2023/2673).
recent_change_note: National rules transposing Directive (EU) 2023/2673 (withdrawal function/button for online contracts) apply from 19 June 2026.
common_misconceptions: The withdrawal period is 7 days
The period is 30 days for online purchases
The extension when information is missing is 3 months
There is no right of withdrawal for online purchases at all

title: GDPR personal data breach: notify the authority within 72 hours
fact_en: A controller must notify a personal data breach to the competent supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to individuals' rights and freedoms.
fact_ko: 처리자는 개인정보 침해를 인지한 후 부당한 지체 없이, 가능하면 72시간 이내에 관할 감독기관에 통지해야 한다. 다만 침해가 개인의 권리와 자유에 위험을 초래할 가능성이 낮은 경우는 예외이다.
common_misconceptions: The deadline is 24 hours
The deadline is 7 days
The deadline is 30 days
Every breach must also be notified to every affected person within 72 hours

title: GDPR right to erasure is not absolute
fact_en: A data subject can obtain erasure of personal data without undue delay where a ground applies (e.g. data no longer necessary, consent withdrawn), but the right does not apply to the extent processing is necessary for e.g. freedom of expression and information or compliance with a legal obligation.
fact_ko: 정보주체는 개인정보가 더 이상 필요하지 않거나 동의가 철회된 경우 등 사유가 있으면 부당한 지체 없이 삭제를 받을 수 있으나, 표현·정보의 자유 행사나 법적 의무 준수에 필요한 처리에는 이 권리가 적용되지 않는다.
common_misconceptions: Erasure must always be granted on request
Erasure applies only to data held by public bodies
Erasure covers backups instantly with no exceptions
The controller has 72 hours to erase

title: EU Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platform discontinued in 2025
fact_en: The European ODR platform for online consumer disputes no longer exists: complaint submission stopped on 20 March 2025 and Regulation (EU) No 524/2013 was repealed with effect from 20 July 2025. Consumers must use national ADR bodies or consumer centres (e.g. European Consumer Centres) instead.
fact_ko: 온라인 소비자 분쟁용 유럽 ODR 플랫폼은 더 이상 존재하지 않는다. 불만 접수는 2025년 3월 20일 중단되었고 규정 (EU) No 524/2013은 2025년 7월 20일부로 폐지되었다. 소비자는 대신 각국 ADR 기관이나 소비자센터(유럽소비자센터 등)를 이용해야 한다.
recent_change_note: Platform closed 20 March 2025 (submissions) and 20 July 2025 (repeal); older advice pointing to ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr is outdated.
common_misconceptions: Consumers can still file complaints on the EU ODR platform
The platform closes at the end of 2026
The ODR platform now handles only B2B disputes
Traders must still link to the ODR platform on their websites

title: New Product Liability Directive: software is a product; applies to products placed on market after 9 Dec 2026
fact_en: Directive (EU) 2024/2853 treats software (including AI) as a ‘product’ for no-fault liability, but excludes free and open-source software developed outside commercial activity. It applies to products placed on the market or put into service after 9 December 2026, the same day as the transposition deadline.
fact_ko: 지침 (EU) 2024/2853은 소프트웨어(AI 포함)를 무과실 책임 대상 ‘제품’으로 보되, 상업 활동 밖에서 개발·공급되는 무료 오픈소스 소프트웨어는 제외한다. 2026년 12월 9일 이후 시장에 출시되거나 사용 개시되는 제품에 적용되며, 이는 국내법 전환 기한과 같은 날이다.
recent_change_note: Transposition deadline and start of application for new products: 9 December 2026.
common_misconceptions: Software is excluded from the Directive
The Directive applies to all products already on the market today
The deadline was 9 December 2024
Free open-source software is always covered

title: European Small Claims Procedure: cross-border claims up to EUR 5,000
fact_en: The European Small Claims Procedure applies to cross-border civil and commercial matters where the value of the claim does not exceed EUR 5,000 at the time the court receives the claim form, excluding interest, expenses and disbursements. It does not cover revenue, customs or administrative matters.
fact_ko: 유럽 소액청구절차는 법원이 청구서를 접수한 시점의 청구가액이 이자·비용·지출을 제외하고 5,000유로를 넘지 않는 국경 간 민사·상사 사건에 적용된다. 조세·관세·행정 사건에는 적용되지 않는다.
legal_basis: Regulation (EC) No 861/2007 Art. 2(1) (as amended by Regulation (EU) 2015/2421)
common_misconceptions: The ceiling is EUR 2,000
The ceiling is EUR 10,000
The procedure also covers purely domestic claims
A lawyer is mandatory

title: Pay Transparency Directive: transposition deadline 7 June 2026; pay history ban
fact_en: Under Directive (EU) 2023/970, Member States had to transpose the rules by 7 June 2026. Job applicants have the right to receive the initial pay or pay range before employment, and employers may not ask about pay history. Many Member States are late, so national rules may not yet be in force.
fact_ko: 지침 (EU) 2023/970에 따라 회원국은 2026년 6월 7일까지 국내법으로 전환해야 했다. 구직자는 채용 전에 초임 또는 급여 범위를 제공받을 권리가 있고 사용자는 급여 이력을 물을 수 없다. 많은 회원국이 지연되어 국내 규정이 아직 시행되지 않았을 수 있다.
recent_change_note: Transposition deadline of 7 June 2026 has passed; national implementation varies.
common_misconceptions: The deadline is 7 June 2028
The Directive directly obliges employers in all Member States already
Employers may ask for previous salary if the applicant agrees
Pay information is only given after the job offer

title: AI Act prohibited practices apply since 2 Feb 2025; fines up to EUR 35 million or 7 %
fact_en: The AI Act's Chapters I and II (including the Art. 5 bans such as social scoring, untargeted facial-image scraping and emotion inference at work or school) apply since 2 February 2025; infringements can be fined up to EUR 35 million or 7 % of worldwide turnover. The Digital Omnibus adds bans on AI generating non-consensual intimate material and child sexual abuse material from 2 December 2026.
fact_ko: AI법 제1장·제2장(사회적 점수화, 안면 이미지 무차별 수집, 직장·학교에서의 감정 추론 등 제5조 금지행위 포함)은 2025년 2월 2일부터 적용되며, 위반 시 최대 3,500만 유로 또는 전 세계 연간 매출의 7%의 과징금이 부과될 수 있다. 디지털 옴니버스는 동의 없는 성적 이미지·아동 성착취물 생성 AI 금지를 2026년 12월 2일부터 추가한다.
recent_change_note: Digital Omnibus (Reg. (EU) 2026/1744) adds Art. 5(1a)-(1b) bans on non-consensual intimate material / CSAM generation applying from 2 Dec 2026.
common_misconceptions: The prohibitions only apply from 2 August 2026
The prohibitions were postponed by the Digital Omnibus
The maximum fine for prohibited practices is EUR 15 million or 3 %
Emotion recognition is banned everywhere, including medical uses

title: Single Digital Gateway: Your Europe as the EU entry point for rules, procedures and help
fact_en: The Single Digital Gateway Regulation set up a gateway integrated into the Your Europe portal that gives access to information on rights and rules under EU and national law, online and offline procedures, and assistance and problem-solving services for citizens and businesses exercising internal-market rights.
fact_ko: 단일 디지털 게이트웨이 규정은 Your Europe 포털에 통합된 게이트웨이를 설치하여, 역내시장 권리를 행사하는 시민과 기업에게 EU·국가법상 권리와 규칙에 관한 정보, 온라인·오프라인 절차, 지원 및 문제해결 서비스에 대한 접근을 제공한다.
common_misconceptions: The EU has no common entry point; users must search each ministry separately
The gateway is run only by national governments
Your Europe is a private commercial service
The gateway only covers businesses, not citizens

title: EU Digital Identity Wallets: Member States must provide one by the end of 2026
fact_en: Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 requires each Member State to provide at least one European Digital Identity Wallet within 24 months of entry into force of the implementing acts; the Commission states Member States must provide wallets to citizens by the end of 2026. Use of the wallet is voluntary.
fact_ko: 규정 (EU) 2024/1183은 각 회원국이 이행 법령 발효 후 24개월 이내에 최소 하나의 유럽 디지털 신원 지갑을 제공하도록 요구하며, 위원회는 회원국이 2026년 말까지 시민에게 지갑을 제공해야 한다고 밝힌다. 지갑 사용은 자발적이다.
effective_date: 2024-05-20 (entry into force); wallets due end of 2026
recent_change_note: Wallet roll-out due by end of 2026; availability still differs by country on 2026-11-01.
common_misconceptions: The wallet is already mandatory for every citizen
Wallets must be provided by 2030
Each Member State must offer at least two wallets
The wallet is issued by the European Commission directly

title: Free movement: 3 months without formalities; registration deadline of at least 3 months
fact_en: EU citizens may reside in another Member State for up to three months with only a valid ID card or passport. For longer stays the host state may require registration, with a deadline of at least three months from arrival, and a registration certificate is issued immediately.
fact_ko: EU 시민은 유효한 신분증이나 여권만으로 다른 회원국에 최대 3개월 체류할 수 있다. 3개월 초과 체류 시 체류국은 등록을 요구할 수 있으며 등록 기한은 도착일로부터 3개월 이상이어야 하고, 등록증명서는 즉시 발급된다.
common_misconceptions: EU citizens need a visa for stays above 30 days
Registration is required within 14 days of arrival
The right of residence up to 3 months requires proof of employment
Registration may be refused for any EU citizen without reason

title: Public documents between Member States: no legalisation or apostille
fact_en: Public documents covered by the Public Documents Regulation (e.g. birth, marriage, residence certificates) and their certified copies issued in one Member State are exempt from all forms of legalisation and apostille when presented in another Member State; translations may be requested, but multilingual standard forms can avoid them.
fact_ko: 공문서 규정의 적용을 받는 공문서(출생·혼인·거주 증명서 등)와 그 인증 사본은 한 회원국에서 발급되어 다른 회원국에 제출될 때 모든 형태의 인증(legalisation)과 아포스티유가 면제된다. 번역이 요구될 수 있으나 다국어 표준양식으로 번역을 피할 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: An apostille is always required between EU Member States
A notarised translation is always required
The exemption covers documents from non-EU countries
The Regulation covers academic diploma recognition

title: EU ID cards: non-compliant cards cease to be valid by 3 August 2031
fact_en: Under Regulation (EU) 2019/1157, identity cards not meeting the new security and format requirements cease to be valid at their expiry or by 3 August 2031, whichever is earlier; some cards without ICAO-compliant security or functional MRZ cease earlier (3 August 2026).
fact_ko: 규정 (EU) 2019/1157에 따라 새 보안·형식 요건을 충족하지 못하는 신분증은 만료일 또는 2031년 8월 3일 중 빠른 때에 효력을 잃으며, ICAO 기준을 충족하지 않거나 기능적 MRZ가 없는 일부 신분증은 2026년 8월 3일에 더 일찍 효력을 잃는다.
recent_change_note: Cards without ICAO-compliant security standards or functional MRZ ceased to be valid on 3 Aug 2026; other non-compliant cards by 3 Aug 2031.
common_misconceptions: All old ID cards remain valid until 2035
All ID cards expire on 3 August 2026
Cards expire on 3 August 2031 even if the printed validity is later and the card is compliant
Passports are also invalidated in 2031

title: AI Act: fundamental-rights impact assessment (Art. 27) for public bodies; high-risk dates moved by the Omnibus
fact_en: Before deploying certain high-risk AI systems (Annex III, except critical infrastructure), public-law bodies and private entities providing public services must carry out a fundamental-rights impact assessment. Because high-risk Annex III obligations now apply from 2 December 2027 (Digital Omnibus), this duty is not yet applicable on 2026-11-01.
fact_ko: 공공법 기관과 공공서비스를 제공하는 민간 주체는 특정 고위험 AI 시스템(핵심 인프라 제외 부속서 III)을 배치하기 전에 기본권 영향평가를 수행해야 한다. 디지털 옴니버스로 부속서 III 고위험 의무 적용일이 2027년 12월 2일로 미뤄졌으므로 2026-11-01 현재 이 의무는 아직 적용되지 않는다.
recent_change_note: Digital Omnibus on AI (Reg. (EU) 2026/1744) postponed Annex III high-risk obligations from 2 Aug 2026 to 2 Dec 2027.
common_misconceptions: The FRIA duty applies from 2 August 2026
FRIA is required of all private companies deploying AI
FRIA duty has been abolished by the Omnibus
The postponement is to 2 August 2028 for Annex III

title: GDPR Art. 22: right not to be subject to solely automated decisions with legal effects
fact_en: A person has the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produces legal effects or similarly significantly affects them, subject to exceptions (contract, law, explicit consent) with safeguards such as human intervention and the right to contest.
fact_ko: 개인은 법적 효과를 초래하거나 이와 유사하게 중대한 영향을 미치는, 프로파일링을 포함한 전적으로 자동화된 처리에만 근거한 결정의 적용을 받지 않을 권리가 있다. 계약·법률·명시적 동의라는 예외가 있으나 인적 개입과 이의 제기권 등의 보호장치가 필요하다.
common_misconceptions: Automated decisions are always banned
Only fully manual decisions are allowed in public administration
The right applies to any decision supported by AI, even with human decision-maker
No safeguards are required if the person consents

title: Interoperable Europe Act: interoperability assessments for public bodies from 12 January 2025
fact_en: The Interoperable Europe Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/903) applies from 12 July 2024, with the duty on Union entities and public sector bodies to carry out an interoperability assessment before deciding on new or substantially modified binding requirements applying from 12 January 2025.
fact_ko: 상호운용 가능한 유럽법(규정 (EU) 2024/903)은 2024년 7월 12일부터 적용되며, EU 기관과 공공부문 기관이 새롭거나 실질적으로 수정된 구속력 있는 요건을 결정하기 전에 상호운용성 평가를 수행할 의무는 2025년 1월 12일부터 적용된다.
common_misconceptions: The Act applies to private companies' IT systems
The assessments have been required since 2024-07-12
The Act replaced the GDPR for public sector data
Applicable only from 2027

title: Erasmus+ association: EEA/EFTA, candidate and other associated third countries; non-associated only in justified cases
fact_en: The Erasmus+ Regulation 2021/817 opens the Programme (2021-2027, budget EUR 24.574 billion) to EEA-EFTA members and to acceding, candidate and potential candidate countries under agreed conditions; legal entities from other third countries not associated to the Programme can take part only in duly justified cases in the Union's interest. Participation rules therefore depend on the country.
fact_ko: Erasmus+ 규정 2021/817은 프로그램(2021~2027, 예산 245.74억 유로)을 EEA-EFTA 회원국과 가입국·후보국·잠재 후보국에 합의된 조건으로 개방하며, 프로그램에 연계되지 않은 그 밖의 제3국의 법인은 EU 이익에 부합하는 정당한 경우에만 참여할 수 있다. 따라서 참여 규정은 국가별로 다르다.
common_misconceptions: Every country in the world is automatically associated to Erasmus+
Erasmus+ is only for EU Member States
The 2021-2027 budget is EUR 14.7 billion
Individual students apply directly to the Commission

title: GDPR Art. 8: child's consent to online services at 16, Member States may lower to 13
fact_en: For information society services offered directly to a child, consent-based processing is lawful if the child is at least 16; below that, consent must be given or authorised by the holder of parental responsibility. Member States may lower the age by law, but not below 13, so the age differs by country.
fact_ko: 아동에게 직접 제공되는 정보사회서비스에서 동의에 근거한 처리는 아동이 만 16세 이상이면 적법하며, 그 미만이면 친권자의 동의 또는 승인이 필요하다. 회원국은 법률로 연령을 낮출 수 있으나 13세 미만은 불가하므로 연령은 국가마다 다르다.
common_misconceptions: The age is 18 everywhere in the EU
The age is 14 everywhere in the EU
Member States may lower it to 10
Parental consent is needed for children under 13 only in all Member States

title: Professional qualifications: recognition gives access to the same profession under the same conditions as nationals
fact_en: Recognition of a professional qualification by the host Member State under Directive 2005/36/EC allows the beneficiary to access and pursue the same profession as in the home state under the same conditions as nationals. It concerns regulated professions; academic recognition of diplomas (e.g. for study) is handled separately through ENIC-NARIC.
fact_ko: 지침 2005/36/EC에 따라 체류국이 직업자격을 인정하면 수혜자는 본국에서와 같은 직업에 대해 자국민과 같은 조건으로 접근하여 종사할 수 있다. 이는 규제 직종에 관한 것이며, 학업 목적의 학위 학술 인정은 ENIC-NARIC을 통해 별도로 처리된다.
common_misconceptions: A diploma from any EU country is automatically valid for every profession
Recognition is automatic for lawyers and doctors in all cases without any procedure
Recognition is needed for non-regulated professions too
Recognition decisions are made by the European Commission

title: AI literacy duty (Art. 4) softened by the Digital Omnibus
fact_en: Since 2 February 2025 AI Act Art. 4 required providers and deployers to ensure AI literacy of staff. The Digital Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, in force July 2026) replaced Art. 4: providers and deployers must take measures to support AI literacy, without guaranteeing any specific level for any individual; the Commission and Member States support and encourage it.
fact_ko: 2025년 2월 2일부터 AI법 제4조는 제공자와 배치자에게 직원의 AI 소양 보장을 요구했다. 디지털 옴니버스(규정 (EU) 2026/1744, 2026년 7월 발효)는 제4조를 대체하여, 제공자와 배치자가 AI 소양 증진을 지원하는 조치를 취하되 개인별 특정 수준을 보장할 필요는 없도록 했고, 위원회와 회원국이 이를 지원·촉진한다.
legal_basis: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Art. 4 as replaced by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 Art. 1(5)
recent_change_note: Art. 4 AI literacy was replaced in July 2026: duty to take measures to support AI literacy, no guarantee of any specific level.
common_misconceptions: Art. 4 now requires certified AI training for every employee
Art. 4 was deleted entirely by the Omnibus
The AI literacy duty only applies to high-risk AI providers
The AI literacy duty first applies in August 2027

title: AI Act Annex III: education AI (admission, grading, exam proctoring) is high-risk; obligations from 2 Dec 2027
fact_en: AI systems used to determine access or admission to educational institutions, evaluate learning outcomes, assess the appropriate level of education or monitor students during tests are listed as high-risk in Annex III point 3. Their obligations now apply from 2 December 2027 (previously 2 August 2026) under the Digital Omnibus.
fact_ko: 교육기관 입학·접근 결정, 학습 성과 평가, 적정 교육 수준 평가, 시험 중 학생 감시에 쓰이는 AI 시스템은 부속서 III 제3호의 고위험으로 열거된다. 디지털 옴니버스에 따라 그 의무는 2027년 12월 2일부터 적용된다(종전 2026년 8월 2일).
recent_change_note: Annex III high-risk obligations postponed from 2 Aug 2026 to 2 Dec 2027 by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744.
common_misconceptions: Education AI is minimal risk under the AI Act
Obligations for education AI already apply since 2 August 2026
They apply from 2 August 2028
Only AI used in universities, not schools, is covered

title: European Accessibility Act: applies since 28 June 2025 to e-books and e-commerce services
fact_en: Directive (EU) 2019/882 requirements apply from 28 June 2025 to covered products placed on the market after that date and to services such as e-books and dedicated software, e-commerce and consumer banking, which matters for digital learning materials and online course shops. Micro-enterprises providing services are exempt.
fact_ko: 지침 (EU) 2019/882의 요건은 2025년 6월 28일부터 그 이후 출시되는 대상 제품과 전자책 및 전용 소프트웨어, 전자상거래, 소비자 은행 서비스 등에 적용되며, 이는 디지털 학습 자료와 온라인 강좌 판매에 중요하다. 서비스를 제공하는 초소기업은 면제된다.
common_misconceptions: The Act applies from 28 June 2030 to all services
It applies only to public schools
E-books are excluded
Micro-enterprises are not exempt

title: Non-EU students may work at least 15 hours per week (Students and Researchers Directive)
fact_en: Under Directive (EU) 2016/801, third-country students are entitled to be employed outside study time, subject to national rules; each Member State sets a weekly/yearly limit that may not be less than 15 hours per week (or equivalent). National rules and prior authorisation may differ.
fact_ko: 지침 (EU) 2016/801에 따라 비EU 학생은 수업 외 시간에 국내 규정에 따라 취업할 권리가 있으며, 각 회원국은 주간·연간 한도를 정하되 주당 15시간(또는 그에 상응하는 일수·월수) 미만이어서는 안 된다. 국가별 규정과 사전 허가는 다를 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: The limit is 10 hours per week everywhere
Students may not work at all
The limit is unlimited
The minimum is 25 hours per week

title: AI Act ban on emotion inference in education institutions (since 2 Feb 2025)
fact_en: AI systems used to infer emotions of a natural person in the areas of workplace and education institutions are prohibited, except for medical or safety reasons. The ban has applied since 2 February 2025, so a school cannot lawfully deploy emotion-recognition cameras to gauge student attention.
fact_ko: 직장과 교육기관에서 자연인의 감정을 추론하는 AI 시스템은 의료 또는 안전 목적을 제외하고 금지된다. 이 금지는 2025년 2월 2일부터 적용되므로, 학교가 학생의 집중도를 파악하기 위해 감정 인식 카메라를 적법하게 도입할 수 없다.
common_misconceptions: Emotion recognition in schools is high-risk but allowed
The ban only applies from August 2026
The ban covers all emotion recognition, including medical
Students' consent makes it lawful
